# AlisPro MediTours

> AlisPro MediTours (alispromeditours.com) helps international patients plan treatment at hospitals in India: choosing a hospital and doctor, getting a treatment plan and cost estimate from the hospital, visas, flights, stay, an interpreter, and follow-up after returning home. It is the medical-tourism service of the Alis Professional Group, New Delhi, whose first company was founded in 1997. AlisPro MediTours does not diagnose or give medical advice; doctors at the treating hospital decide on treatment.

- Address: 238 Westend Mall, Janakpuri, New Delhi 110058, India
- Patient line and WhatsApp: +91 98217 01155
- Email: care@alispromeditours.com
- Enquiries answered 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Languages: English, Arabic, Russian, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Romanian, Bengali, Vietnamese

## Treatments

- [Treatments](https://alispromeditours.com/treatments/): cardiac care, orthopaedics and joint replacement, cancer care, fertility and IVF, organ transplant, and more
